outputs.explanation: Spatial deconvolution plots show color-coded cell fractions on tissue sections; no significance symbols are present.

The box/scatter plot displays **** and *** symbols above each pairwise comparison, and the caption provides the exact p-value corresponding to each symbol for every immune cell population, along with the statistical test used (two-sided Mann–Whitney–Wilcoxon test) and sample sizes. This is sufficient to interpret the significance indicators.
GSEA enrichment plots report exact NES, FDR and p values directly on the plot; no significance symbols are used.
Exact p-values are printed above each bar rather than significance symbols, so there are no symbols requiring definition.
This panel consists of H&E and IHC micrographs with no quantitative plot or significance symbols.
